description: Per-field options for a match_phrase_prefix clause. Carried as the value of the field-keyed match_phrase_prefix map (the map key is the column name).

query.description: Required. The phrase whose last term is treated as a prefix. A string.

slop.description: Optional. Number of positions allowed between matching terms. Default 0.

max_expansions.description: Optional. Maximum number of terms the last (prefix) term expands into. Default 50.
